6626.header: The Route 92 will operate on Detour as the result of Construction at the Fall Creek Dr. and Stewart
6626.message: The Route 92 will operate on Detour as the result of Construction at the Fall Creek Dr. and Stewart Ave intersection. Beginning May 4th until mid-November 2026. From West Ave. the detour will bypass Stewart Ave and take University Ave. to Thurston Ave.

7014.header: Starting Monday 5/18/26 Route 10s will start using Tioga Street. Temporary bus Stop for Seneca Stree
7014.message: Starting Monday 5/18/26 Route 10s will start using Tioga Street. Temporary bus Stop for Seneca Street will be relocated to Tioga @ Buffalo.

7454.message: Weekday Route 31 is unable to use Garden Ave due to construction. Detour will be Campus to Wing to Tower. Garden Ave stop moved to Kennedy Hall.

7458.message: due to road closures for apple fest routes 15 & 11s Detour will be using Albany to Green to Geneva. Relocated stop of Geneva @ State will be Albany @ State.

7469.message: Due to road closures on Cayuga St. the Rts 13 & 17 will be detouring using Albany to Cascadilla inbound and outbound.
